ABOUT THE PROGRAM

Helping children make smarter choices.

The Smart Child Awareness Program was conducted at Sri Sowdambika Nursery School as an initiative to create awareness among young children about responsible technology usage.

The program encouraged children to balance screen time with outdoor activities, learning, creativity, physical activity and interaction with family and friends.
